name: @okcontract/entropy-mixer
description: An inspectable browser entropy mixer for raw keys, BIP-39 phrases, and Bitcoin or Ethereum private keys.
author: OKcontract Pte. Ltd.

scripts.release:checksums: bun run build && bun run scripts/write-checksums.ts
scripts.lint: biome check build.ts e2e index.html package.json playwright.config.ts scripts src tsconfig.json
scripts.format: biome check --write build.ts e2e index.html package.json playwright.config.ts scripts src tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.check:release: bun run check && bun run test:e2e
